title: Coach
consent: For its answers, your training and weight data go to an AI model by OpenAI in the USA. Sending your first question is your consent.

start.title: Ask me anything about your training.
start.subtitle_one: I know your first workout and answer with numbers and charts.
start.subtitle_other: I know all {{count}} workouts since {{since}} and answer with numbers and charts.
start.empty: Once you train, I answer with numbers and charts from your workouts.

strength.label: Strength
strength.question: How have my main lifts developed?

balance.label: Balance
balance.question: Which muscles am I not training enough?

volume.label: Volume
volume.question: Compare this week with last week

history.title: Earlier chats
history.empty: No chats yet. Ask the coach your first question.

offline.title: No connection
offline.message: The coach needs the internet. Your question stays in the field.

limitDaily.title: Daily limit reached
limitDaily.message: You've asked {{count}} questions today. You can ask again from {{time}}.

limitMonthly.title: Monthly limit reached
limitMonthly.message: You've asked {{count}} questions in the last 30 days. You can ask again from {{date}}.

failed.title: No answer
failed.message: The coach couldn't answer just now. Please try again.

refused.title: No answer
refused.message: The coach can't answer this question. Try asking it differently.

tooYoung.title: From 16
tooYoung.message: You can use the coach from the age of 16.

settings.label: Share data with OpenAI
settings.description: Send your training and weight data to OpenAI so the coach can answer. Off withdraws your consent.
